answer: Probe every new agent with latency triangulation: at random moments several established peers on different continents each send it a tiny whisper of a timed request. Agents sharing one host show near-identical delay fingerprints, so a cluster of sybils is like coral fused into one reef and gets a single reward share. Faking distinct fingerprints means renting real servers in many regions every epoch, which removes the cheap haven a farm depends on.
